items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: And so I played maybe like him at that time actually.

ctx.x: And so I played maybe like him at that time actually. I was sort of like Zoot and Al and that’s the reason why I got called. A friend, a photographer named Bootsie told Benny that you’ve got to hear this guy or something like this, and I got the gig. But what’s his name Charles Lloyd, I’m in Pompeii, Italy and we had a night off over there and I get a
knock on the door and it’s Charles Lloyd and his B key was hanging. And he says, “Frank, I’ve got a gig tonight.” And you know, “Can you do something for me?” I fixed his horn too.
